card.title: Command with an Escape Hatch
card.instruction: Carry yourself as though every decision settles the matter, while preserving one ambiguity that lets you later reverse what the decision meant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may borrow the car for a short trip. That's settled.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. I'll drive forty miles to the airport.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Short means the station at the end of our road. You're approved for that.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That works. I'll park there until I fly back next week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Short includes the car's stay. Return it before you catch the train. The permission stands.
